design_references.claim: Six rule categories (Validation/Calculation/Routing/Limit-check/Error-handling/Compliance) and their keyword signals.
design_references.source: reference/.claude/skills/condition-classifier/SKILL.md — categories are language-agnostic; adapted field-naming heuristics from COBOL WS-/IO- prefixes to Oracle p_/v_ prefixes.

design_references.claim: CHECK constraints and named business exceptions scored at top confidence without SME review.
design_references.source: reference/.claude/skills/rule-tagger/SKILL.md — same status COBOL 88-level conditions get, for the identical reason: enforced/named by the source, not inferred from procedural code.

business_rules.name: Restrict Account Status to allowed values
business_rules.description: The database defines: account_status IN ('ACTIVE','DORMANT','CLOSED') (table ACCOUNTS). Constraint is ENABLED and VALIDATED — enforced by the database for all data.

business_rules.name: Validate Principal
business_rules.description: When p_principal IS NULL OR p_principal <= 0, the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in FUNC-.FN_CALCULATE_SIMPLE_INTEREST, line 19.
business_rules.outcome_text: reject the operation with error -20001: Principal amount must be greater than zero.

business_rules.name: Validate Annual Rate
business_rules.description: When p_annual_rate IS NULL OR p_annual_rate < 0, the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in FUNC-.FN_CALCULATE_SIMPLE_INTEREST, line 23.
business_rules.outcome_text: reject the operation with error -20002: Interest rate cannot be negative.

business_rules.name: Validate Tenure Days
business_rules.description: When p_tenure_days IS NULL OR p_tenure_days <= 0, the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in FUNC-.FN_CALCULATE_SIMPLE_INTEREST, line 27.
business_rules.outcome_text: reject the operation with error -20003: Tenure in days must be greater than zero.

business_rules.name: Validate Day Count Basis is 360
business_rules.description: When p_day_count_basis = '360', the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in FUNC-.FN_CALCULATE_SIMPLE_INTEREST, line 32.

business_rules.name: Apply default Day Count Basis handling
business_rules.description: When none of the preceding Day Count Basis conditions hold, the system applies its default handling. Implemented in FUNC-.FN_CALCULATE_SIMPLE_INTEREST, line 35.

business_rules.name: Validate Current Status is ACTIVE
business_rules.description: When v_days_inactive > 365 AND v_current_status = 'ACTIVE', the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_UPDATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT_STATUS, line 27.
business_rules.outcome_text: update accounts and set Result to 'ACCOUNT_MARKED_DORMANT'

business_rules.name: Validate Current Status is DORMANT
business_rules.description: When v_days_inactive <= 365 AND v_current_status = 'DORMANT', the system applies the corresponding handling (ELSIF branch 1). Implemented in PROC-.SP_UPDATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT_STATUS, line 40.
business_rules.outcome_text: update accounts and set Result to 'ACCOUNT_REACTIVATED'

business_rules.name: Apply default Current Status handling
business_rules.description: When none of the preceding Current Status conditions hold, the system applies its default handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_UPDATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT_STATUS, line 49.

business_rules.name: Report missing Accounts record
business_rules.description: When the database reports NO_DATA_FOUND — the requested record does not exist or the query returned no row — the system responds with: p_result := 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND'. Implemented in PROC-.SP_UPDATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT_STATUS, line 55.

business_rules.name: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for SAVINGS_REGULAR
business_rules.description: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_REGULAR', Minimum Balance Req is 1000. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 29.

business_rules.name: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for SAVINGS_PREMIUM
business_rules.description: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_PREMIUM', Minimum Balance Req is 10000. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 30.

business_rules.name: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for SAVINGS_ZERO_BAL
business_rules.description: When v_account_type = 'SAVINGS_ZERO_BAL', Minimum Balance Req is 0. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 31.

business_rules.name: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for CURRENT_REGULAR
business_rules.description: When v_account_type = 'CURRENT_REGULAR', Minimum Balance Req is 5000. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 32.

business_rules.name: Enforce Minimum Balance Req for CURRENT_PREMIUM
business_rules.description: When v_account_type = 'CURRENT_PREMIUM', Minimum Balance Req is 25000. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 33.

business_rules.name: Enforce default Minimum Balance Req
business_rules.description: When no other case matches, Minimum Balance Req defaults to 1000. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 34.

business_rules.name: Enforce Current Balance at or above Minimum Balance Req
business_rules.description: When v_current_balance >= v_min_balance_req, the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 37.
business_rules.outcome_text: set Shortfall Amount to 0 and set Penalty Amount to 0

business_rules.name: Apply default Current Balance handling
business_rules.description: When none of the preceding Current Balance conditions hold, the system applies its default handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 42.
business_rules.outcome_text: set Shortfall Amount to v_min_balance_req - v_current_balance and set Penalty Amount to LEAST(500, GREATEST(50, ROUND(p_shortfall_amount * 0.05, 2)))

business_rules.name: Report missing Accounts record
business_rules.description: When the database reports NO_DATA_FOUND — the requested record does not exist or the query returned no row — the system responds with: p_message := 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND'; p_penalty_amount := NULL. Implemented in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 50.

business_rules.name: Restrict processing to eligible Accounts records
business_rules.description: This process applies only to rows of accounts where account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_type LIKE 'SAVINGS%'. Records outside this population are not processed. Defined by cursor c_savings_accounts in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 17.

business_rules.name: Enforce Balance below 100,000
business_rules.description: When rec.balance < 100000, the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 38.

business_rules.name: Enforce Balance below 1,000,000
business_rules.description: When rec.balance < 1000000, the system applies the corresponding handling (ELSIF branch 1). Implemented in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 41.

business_rules.name: Enforce Balance below 10,000,000
business_rules.description: When rec.balance < 10000000, the system applies the corresponding handling (ELSIF branch 2). Implemented in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 43.

business_rules.name: Apply default Balance handling
business_rules.description: When none of the preceding Balance conditions hold, the system applies its default handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 45.

business_rules.name: Validate Interest Amount above 0
business_rules.description: When v_interest_amount > 0, the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 54.
business_rules.outcome_text: set New Balance to rec.balance + v_interest_amount and update accounts

business_rules.name: Isolate per-record failures from the batch
business_rules.description: A failure while processing one record is recorded and the run continues; a single bad record must not abort the batch. Implemented in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 76.
business_rules.condition_text: unhandled error on a single record
business_rules.outcome_text: record the failure and continue with the remaining records

business_rules.name: Report run failure as error -20010
business_rules.description: An unrecoverable failure rolls the run back and reports application error -20010 to the caller. Callers depend on this code. Implemented in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 92.
business_rules.outcome_text: roll back the run and report application error -20010 to the caller

business_rules.name: Validate Amount
business_rules.description: The operation must not proceed when p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0. Violation raises e_invalid_amount (PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 36).

business_rules.name: Validate From Account is To Account
business_rules.description: When p_from_account = p_to_account, the system applies the corresponding handling. Implemented in PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 39.
business_rules.outcome_text: set Status to 'FAILED' and set Message to 'Source and destination accounts cannot be the same.'

business_rules.name: Require the Accounts record for From Account to exist
business_rules.description: The referenced row in accounts must exist. If the lookup returns no data the operation is rejected and e_account_not_found is raised (PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 56).

business_rules.name: Validate From Status is ACTIVE
business_rules.description: The operation must not proceed when v_from_status <> 'ACTIVE'. Violation raises e_account_inactive (PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 60).

business_rules.name: Require the Accounts record for To Account to exist
business_rules.description: The referenced row in accounts must exist. If the lookup returns no data the operation is rejected and e_account_not_found is raised (PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 71).

business_rules.name: Validate To Status is ACTIVE
business_rules.description: The operation must not proceed when v_to_status <> 'ACTIVE'. Violation raises e_account_inactive (PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 75).

business_rules.name: Enforce From Balance at or above Amount
business_rules.description: The operation must not proceed when v_from_balance < p_amount. Violation raises e_insufficient_balance (PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 79).

business_rules.name: Enforce Amount
business_rules.description: The operation must not proceed when (v_today_txn_total + p_amount) > v_daily_limit. Violation raises e_daily_limit_exceeded (PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 91).

business_rules.name: Determine Interest
business_rules.description: Interest is derived as: v_interest := ROUND( (p_principal * p_annual_rate * p_tenure_days) / (100 * v_basis_days), 2 ). It depends on Annual Rate, Principal, Tenure Days, Basis Days. Defined in FUNC-.FN_CALCULATE_SIMPLE_INTEREST, line 39.

business_rules.name: Determine Days Inactive
business_rules.description: Days Inactive is derived as: v_days_inactive := p_as_of_date - NVL(v_last_txn_date, p_as_of_date - 9999). It depends on Account Number, Account Status, Last Transaction Date, Account Number. Defined in PROC-.SP_UPDATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT_STATUS, line 25.

business_rules.name: Determine Penalty Amount
business_rules.description: Penalty Amount is derived as: p_penalty_amount := LEAST(500, GREATEST(50, ROUND(p_shortfall_amount * 0.05, 2))). It depends on Account Number, Account Type, Balance, Current Premium. Defined in PROC-.SP_CHECK_MINIMUM_BALANCE, line 45.

business_rules.name: Determine Days In Month
business_rules.description: Days In Month is derived as: v_days_in_month := EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(p_run_date)). It depends on Day, Extract, Run Date. Defined in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 32.

business_rules.name: Determine Interest Amount
business_rules.description: Interest Amount is derived as: v_interest_amount := ROUND( rec.balance * (v_interest_rate / 100) * (v_days_in_month / 365), 2 ). It depends on Balance, Day, Extract, Run Date. Defined in PROC-.SP_PROCESS_MONTHLY_INTEREST_CREDIT, line 49.

business_rules.name: Determine Today Transaction Total
business_rules.description: Today Transaction Total is derived as: SELECT NVL(SUM(txn_amount), 0) INTO v_today_txn_total FROM transaction_ledger WHERE account_number = p_from_account AND txn_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND TRUNC(txn_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE). It depends on Account Number, From Account, Transfer Out, Transaction Amount. Defined in PROC-.SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, line 83.
business_rules.condition_text: SELECT NVL(SUM(txn_amount), 0) INTO v_today_txn_total FROM transaction_ledger WHERE account_number = p_from_account AND txn_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND TRUNC(txn_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
